title: Children Bundled on Ferry Boat Railing, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Three young siblings bundled up in dark winter coats and hats stand against a boat deck railing overlooking calm open water. An older boy holds a toddler in a bonnet, while another child wearing a knit cap stands beside them. The reverse of the photograph displays heavy black paper and adhesive remnants from its previous placement in an album.
